## Resource: scalr_datadog_integration

Manages the state of Datadog integrations in Scalr.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scalr_datadog_integration" "example" {
  name           = "datadog"
  api_key        = var.datadog_api_key
  deployment_url = "https://us5.datadoghq.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Datadog API key.
- `name` (String) Name of the Datadog integration.

### Optional

- `deployment_url` (String) URL of the Datadog site, e.g. `https://us5.datadoghq.com`. If not set, `https://api.datadoghq.com` is used.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) ID of the account the integration belongs to.
- `err_message` (String) Error message reported by Scalr when the integration is in the `failed` status.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Status of the integration: `active`, `disabled` or `failed`. Scalr sets the `failed` status when the integration cannot connect to Datadog.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import scalr_datadog_integration.example in-xxxxxxxxxx
```
